status_help: working through the tutorial and preps
can do the modified / prep version cleanly
the classical version, controlled, breathing with the movement
level_notes: Levels follow the classical mat order from Joseph Pilates' Return to Life: Fundamentals are the pre-Pilates basics every studio teaches first; Beginner = the 'basic five' and their neighbours; Intermediate/Advanced/Advanced+ follow how the 34 are usually staged. Props and reformer sit at the end as a separate track.

skills.name: Lateral breathing & neutral spine
skills.how: Breathe into the sides of the ribs, not the belly; find the pelvis position where the hip bones and pubic bone are level.
skills.cues: Exhale to engage, inhale to lengthen. Neutral is a position, not a brace.
skills.watch: Gripping the abs so hard you stop breathing.

skills.name: Imprint vs neutral
skills.how: Learn to press the low back gently toward the mat (imprint) and release to neutral — the two spine settings used in every supine exercise.
skills.cues: Imprint when both legs are in the air; neutral when one foot is down.
skills.watch: Imprinting by tucking the tailbone hard — it should be a soft lengthening.

skills.name: Pelvic curl (bridge)
skills.how: Exhale, roll the pelvis up one vertebra at a time to a bridge, inhale at the top, roll down from the ribs.
skills.cues: Peel and re-lay the spine like a strip of tape.
skills.watch: Lifting from the lower back instead of the tail.

skills.name: Chest lift & toe taps
skills.how: Chest lift: curl head and shoulders up with the pelvis still. Toe taps: tabletop legs, lower one foot to tap the mat without the back arching.
skills.cues: Ribs knit down; the movement is in the hips, not the spine.
skills.watch: Chin jutting; back arching on the tap.

skills.name: Dead bug
skills.how: Opposite arm and leg reach away while the trunk stays completely still.
skills.cues: Exhale on the reach; ribs down.
skills.watch: Any wobble in the pelvis means shorten the lever.

skills.name: Cat / spinal articulation
skills.how: On hands and knees, round the spine one segment at a time, then lengthen back to flat.
skills.cues: Move from the tail up, then the head down.
skills.watch: Only the mid-back moving — find the stiff segments.

skills.name: Wall roll-down
skills.how: Back against the wall, roll the spine off it from the head down and back up, one vertebra at a time.
skills.cues: Heavy head, soft knees, pelvis stays on the wall.
skills.watch: Hinging at the hips instead of rolling the spine.

skills.name: Side-lying leg series & clam
skills.how: Lying on the side, hips stacked: clams, lifts, small circles.
skills.cues: Waist lifted off the mat; top hip stays stacked.
skills.watch: Rolling back to lift higher.
skills.yt_by: Side leg series · Pilates From Home

skills.name: Standing footwork & posture
skills.how: Pilates stance, relevés, knee bends and heel lowers — the reformer footwork done standing.
skills.cues: Weight even across the feet; ribs over hips.
skills.watch: Ankles rolling in.

skills.name: 20-minute beginner class (follow-along)
skills.how: Press play twice a week until the fundamentals feel automatic.
skills.cues: Quality over reps — stop when the form goes.
skills.watch: Skipping this to get to the 'real' exercises.

skills.name: 1 · The Hundred
skills.how: Head and shoulders up, legs in tabletop or extended, arms pump for 100 counts breathing in for 5 and out for 5.
skills.cues: Pump from the back, not the wrists; eyes on the knees.
skills.watch: Neck strain — keep the legs higher or head down.

skills.name: 2 · Roll Up
skills.how: From lying flat, arms overhead, roll up through the spine to reach past the toes, roll back down.
skills.cues: Chin to chest, scoop, exhale over the legs.
skills.watch: Using momentum or the hip flexors — do the 7 progressions first.

skills.name: 3 · Roll Over
skills.how: Legs go over the head to parallel with the floor, open, and roll back down slowly.
skills.cues: Lift from the abdominals, not by throwing the legs.
skills.watch: Weight on the neck — this is a shoulder-and-abs exercise.

skills.name: 4 · Single Leg Circle
skills.how: One leg to the ceiling, circle it across the body and around while the pelvis stays still.
skills.cues: Circle small until the hips don't move; accent up.
skills.watch: Rocking hips — the whole point is stillness.

skills.name: 5 · Rolling Like a Ball
skills.how: Balance in a tight ball, roll back to the shoulder blades and return to balance without the feet touching.
skills.cues: Keep the shape; the breath does the rolling.
skills.watch: Rolling onto the neck.

skills.name: 6 · Single Leg Stretch
skills.how: Head up, one knee in, other leg long; switch with control. First of the 'series of five'.
skills.cues: Outside hand on the ankle, inside hand on the knee; torso still.
skills.watch: Shoulders rocking side to side.

skills.name: 7 · Double Leg Stretch
skills.how: Ball position, reach arms and legs away on the inhale, circle arms and hug in on the exhale.
skills.cues: Head stays up the whole time; reach long, not high.
skills.watch: Back arching when the legs go out.

skills.name: 8 · Single Straight Leg Stretch (scissors)
skills.how: Both legs straight, pull one toward you with two pulses while the other hovers; switch.
skills.cues: Pulse-pulse-switch; hips anchored.
skills.watch: Bending the knees to reach the ankle — hold higher up.

skills.name: 9 · Double Straight Leg Stretch (lower-lift)
skills.how: Hands behind the head, legs together to the ceiling, lower them toward the mat and lift.
skills.cues: Lower only as far as the back stays down.
skills.watch: Low back lifting — the range is smaller than you think.

skills.name: 10 · Criss Cross
skills.how: Single leg stretch with rotation: elbow toward the opposite knee.
skills.cues: Rotate from the ribs; keep the elbows wide.
skills.watch: Pulling on the neck; hips lifting.

skills.name: 11 · Spine Stretch Forward
skills.how: Seated, legs apart, round forward from the crown of the head as if over a beach ball, then restack.
skills.cues: Grow taller as you fold; the low back stays lifted.
skills.watch: Collapsing forward from the hips.

skills.name: 12 · Open Leg Rocker
skills.how: Balance holding the ankles in a V, roll back to the shoulders and return to balance.
skills.cues: Keep the V; return with the chest lifted.
skills.watch: Rolling too far onto the neck.
skills.prereq: Rolling Like a Ball, Spine Stretch

skills.name: 13 · Corkscrew
skills.how: Legs together, circle them one way then reverse — the advanced version lifts the hips over.
skills.cues: Circles start small; shoulders pinned.
skills.watch: Arching the low back at the far side of the circle.

skills.name: 14 · Saw
skills.how: Seated wide, twist and reach the little finger past the opposite little toe, 'sawing' three times.
skills.cues: Both hips stay down; twist first, then reach.
skills.watch: Lifting the back hip to reach further.

skills.name: 15 · Swan (prep) → Swan Dive
skills.how: Prone back extension pressing through the hands (Swan); the Dive rocks forward and back with arms released.
skills.cues: Long neck, legs reaching back, chest opens forward.
skills.watch: Crunching the low back; do Swan prep for a long time first.

skills.name: 16–17 · Single Leg Kick & Double Leg Kick
skills.how: Prone on the forearms, kick one heel to the seat with two pulses; then hands clasped behind, kick both and extend into a back arch.
skills.cues: Pubic bone into the mat; chest lifted and open.
skills.watch: Hips lifting on the kick.

skills.name: 18 · Neck Pull
skills.how: Roll Up with hands behind the head and legs hip-width; sit tall at the top, hinge back, then roll down.
skills.cues: Elbows wide; hinge before you round.
skills.watch: Yanking the neck — hands are a frame, not a handle.

skills.name: 19–20 · High Scissors & Bicycle
skills.how: Hips lifted and supported by the hands, legs split (scissors) then pedal (bicycle).
skills.cues: Hips stacked over the elbows; legs long.
skills.watch: Weight in the neck.

skills.name: 21 · Shoulder Bridge
skills.how: Bridge, then one leg extends and kicks up and down while the pelvis stays level.
skills.cues: Kick from the hip; hips don't drop on the lower.
skills.watch: Hamstring cramping — start with smaller kicks.

skills.name: 22 · Spine Twist
skills.how: Seated tall, legs together, twist the torso with two pulses each side, arms wide.
skills.cues: Grow taller as you turn; hips glued.
skills.watch: Swinging the arms instead of turning the spine.

skills.name: 23 · Jackknife
skills.how: Roll Over that finishes with the legs shooting to the ceiling in a shoulder stand, then lowers with control.
skills.cues: Lift through the hips; lower the spine one bone at a time.
skills.watch: Landing heavily — the lower is the exercise.

skills.name: 24 · Side Kick series
skills.how: Side-lying, legs slightly forward: front/back kicks, up/down, small circles, inner thigh lifts.
skills.cues: Torso like a plank; move only the leg.
skills.watch: Rocking the hip back on the front kick.

skills.name: 25 · Teaser
skills.how: Roll up into a V-sit with legs at 45°, arms parallel to the legs; roll down with control. Teaser 1, 2, 3 variations.
skills.cues: Reach forward as you roll; balance on the back of the sit bones.
skills.watch: Falling into the low back — regress to one leg.

skills.name: 26 · Hip Circles
skills.how: Teaser-ish V on the hands, legs circle together one way then the other.
skills.cues: Chest open; the torso doesn't move.
skills.watch: Shoulders collapsing forward.

skills.name: 27 · Swimming
skills.how: Prone, lift opposite arm and leg alternately in a quick flutter while the trunk stays long.
skills.cues: Reach long, not high; breathe in for 5, out for 5.
skills.watch: Compressing the low back.

skills.name: 28 · Leg Pull Front
skills.how: Plank; lift one leg, rock back on the standing heel and forward, lower; switch.
skills.cues: Hips level; push the floor away.
skills.watch: Hips sagging or piking.

skills.name: 29 · Leg Pull Back
skills.how: Reverse plank; kick one leg up and lower with control; switch.
skills.cues: Hips high; chest open; fingers point toward the feet or away.
skills.watch: Wrists — warm them up and turn the hands out if needed.

skills.name: 30 · Kneeling Side Kick
skills.how: Kneeling on one knee with the hand down, kick the free leg front and back at hip height.
skills.cues: Hip stays over the knee; torso still.
skills.watch: Sinking into the supporting shoulder.

skills.name: 31 · Side Bend / Mermaid
skills.how: From a side sit, press up into a side plank arc, reach over the top, and return.
skills.cues: Lift the hips as you arc; long line from heel to fingertips.
skills.watch: Wrist collapsing — stack the shoulder over it.

skills.name: 32 · Boomerang
skills.how: Roll Over, switch the leg cross, roll up to Teaser, sweep the arms behind, fold forward — a combination of everything before it.
skills.cues: Slow; each part is its own exercise.
skills.watch: Rushing the leg switch.

skills.name: 33 · Seal
skills.how: Rolling Like a Ball holding the ankles from inside, clapping the feet three times at each end.
skills.cues: Round the back; balance at the top before the claps.
skills.watch: Rolling onto the neck.

skills.name: 33b · Crab
skills.how: Seal with the legs crossed and a switch at the top, finishing with the crown of the head on the mat.
skills.cues: Control the head touch; it's a kiss, not a headstand.
skills.watch: Neck — skip the head touch until the roll is controlled.

skills.name: 34a · Rocking
skills.how: Prone, hold the ankles in a bow shape and rock forward and back.
skills.cues: Kick the feet into the hands to lift the chest.
skills.watch: Knee strain — needs Swan and Double Leg Kick first.

skills.name: 34b · Control Balance
skills.how: Roll Over holding one ankle overhead while the other leg reaches to the ceiling; switch.
skills.cues: Hips over the shoulders; reach both legs in opposite directions.
skills.watch: Weight on the neck.

skills.name: 34c · Pilates Push Up
skills.how: Roll down to the floor, walk the hands out to plank, three push-ups, walk back and roll up.
skills.cues: Elbows brush the ribs; the walk-out is part of the exercise.
skills.watch: Head dropping in the plank.

skills.name: Magic circle basics
skills.how: Ring between the ankles, knees or hands to add feedback and resistance to the mat work.
skills.cues: Squeeze on the exhale; don't let the ring do the work.
skills.watch: Gripping the ring with the neck and shoulders.
skills.yt_by: How to use the magic circle

skills.name: Reformer: footwork
skills.how: Lying on the carriage, press out and in on toes, arches, heels — the first reformer series.
skills.cues: Pelvis still; move from the hips and knees evenly.
skills.watch: Locking the knees at the end of the press.

skills.name: Reformer: Long Stretch series & Elephant
skills.how: Plank on the carriage (Long Stretch), rounded standing fold pushing the carriage with the legs (Elephant).
skills.cues: Move the carriage with the whole body, not the arms.
skills.watch: Shoulders creeping to the ears.
skills.yt_by: Beginner reformer · Mermaid, Long Stretch, Elephant
